CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to these identified contents.

COD.rationale: Identified content (red coordinates) and an explicit organization/status (origin JSON with represented_time) are both present and distinct for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition statement linking attention to the identified content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: The report explicitly names represented contents (p0/current/n0) and attributes (red, origin) with concrete values.

D.rationale: The content identity (red coordinate set) is presented separately from an explicit status/organization field (origin JSON), distinguishing content from its status.

O.rationale: The origin/represented_time metadata describes how the content is represented/accessed (a completed_record with represented_time).
